hypothesis: Giving the action head the exact five-byte arithmetic record at every decode step will enable range-disjoint arithmetic extrapolation that a downstream adapter behind the frozen recurrence could not learn.

mechanism_change.name: persistent exact operand-context bypass
mechanism_change.decode_positions: 0 through 7; the same decoded record is retained and supplied at every autoregressive output step

data_contract.target: space followed by reversed decimal result

held_out.add: 30 <= x,y <= 59; result support 60 through 118, fully disjoint from training result support
held_out.subtract: 30 <= y <= x <= 59; result support 0 through 29, operand-disjoint but intentionally result-support-overlapping
held_out.multiply: 13 <= x,y <= 24; result support 169 through 576, fully disjoint from training result support

split_invariants: held-out operand tuples are disjoint from training for every operation
held-out rows are excluded from training, checkpoint selection, and tuning
add and multiply are the primary out-of-result-support extrapolation probes

candidate.context: correct five-byte record and correct decode position

context_permuted_control.context: deterministic derangement of five-byte contexts within operation, target-decimal-length, and split strata; a separate held-out derangement is sealed before training
context_permuted_control.purpose: isolates the causal value of the new bypass while preserving context marginals

target_shuffle_control.context: correct five-byte record and correct decode position
target_shuffle_control.targets: deterministically shuffled within operation and target-decimal-length strata using the unchanged original campaign control

zero_update_control.context: correct five-byte record and correct decode position

required_equalities: identical parameter names, tensor shapes, and scalar count
identical optimizer, learning rate, batch size, update count, sampler order, and checkpoint schedule
identical training row identities before the single prespecified context or target derangement
identical evaluation rows and exact-output evaluator
parameter_match_contract.initial_state_receipt: SHA-256 over every trainable tensor before the first update must match across all three trained arms per seed
parameter_match_contract.derangement_receipt: SHA-256 over source-row to control-row assignments must be written before the first update

gates.secondary_metric: macro mean of per-operation exact accuracy
gates.uncertainty: candidate mean delta must exceed two times pooled sample standard deviation against every required control on both metrics, and the deterministic paired held-out bootstrap must have a strictly positive one-sided 95% lower bound for exact accuracy and the operation-stratified macro accuracy
gates.finite_evaluation: rebuild the per-example correctness ledgers independently; use at least 4096 paired bootstrap draws with a sealed seed, sampling held-out rows for exact accuracy and sampling within operation strata for the equal-weight macro metric
gates.zero_check: every candidate seed must have nonzero exact accuracy for add, subtract, and multiply
gates.out_of_support_check: every candidate seed must have nonzero add and multiply exact accuracy and must beat both trained controls for each operation
gates.retention: counting accuracy must equal the sealed parent per seed and every e., g., and count_head. tensor must remain bit-identical
gates.independent_replay: regenerate all rows and control assignments, verify all model and lineage hashes, and replay every candidate/control/zero held-out prediction
gates.falsification: reject the bypass hypothesis if any required gate fails

requirements_before_any_launch: implement and hash the context module, sealed control assignments, runner, and independent verifier
prove exact 142164-parameter parity and bit-identical initialization across trained arms
pass focused unit tests for record decoding, persistent context across all decode steps, split invariants, and frozen tensor identity
satisfy the unchanged storage, RAM, commit, and cloud-access gates

prototype_bindings.scope: Synthetic mechanism and control validation only; no sealed parent checkpoint was loaded and no cloud campaign was launched.
